description: Provable core of the log-type k(A): w_std(k)=E_Planch[f^{lambda/(2,1)}] grows SUPER-EXPONENTIALLY (strictly increasing ratios + w_std/2^k increasing tail, factorial class; q0 preserves the class). Inverting it against extensive B~A forces k~log A (at most log A/log log A), excluding k~A and k~bond-count. No scale, no closure; conditional on the connected-tower picture.

assertions.name: wstd_ratios_strictly_increasing_super_geometric
assertions.detail: w_std(k)/w_std(k-1) = [1.375, 1.855, 2.265, 2.281, 2.414, 2.62, 2.875] strictly up -> SUPER-geometric (exceeds every fixed c*r^k)

assertions.name: wstd_super_exponential
assertions.detail: w_std(k)/2^k for k=3..10: [0.0833, 0.0573, 0.0531, 0.0602, 0.0686, 0.0828, 0.1085, 0.1559] — increasing in the tail (k>=6) -> beats 2^k; with the growing ratio (check 1) it beats every fixed C^k -> SUPER-EXPONENTIAL (factorial class)

assertions.name: q0_same_growth_class_as_q1
assertions.detail: w_std(q0)/w_std(q=1) in (0.3,3) for all k -> the q0 deformation preserves the super-geometric growth class (the bound is robust)

result.weight_convention_q0: W_lambda = d_q^2 / Sigma_mu d_q^2 (SELF-NORMALIZED). The q=1 column needs no such correction: (f^lambda)^2/k! sums to 1 exactly by Burnside, so checks 1 and 2 -- which carry the super-geometric / super-exponential claim -- are untouched by this. Bean qou-uk8o.
result.verdict: PROVABLE CORE VERIFIED (no closure): w_std(k) = E_Planch[f^{lambda/(2,1)}] (exact at q=1) has STRICTLY INCREASING successive ratios (1.38->2.88 over k=3..10) and w_std(k)/2^k increasing in the tail -> SUPER-EXPONENTIAL (factorial growth class, ratio itself unbounded), and the q0 deformation preserves this class. This is the clean combinatorial lemma behind the log-type k(A): inverting a super-EXPONENTIALLY growing w_std against an EXTENSIVE (linear-in-A) binding target structurally forces the jet level to grow only ~log A (in fact at most log A / log log A for factorial growth), EXCLUDING k~A and k~bond-count without any fit. Sets no scale; the connected-tower picture (B ~ scale*w_std(k(A))) + extensivity remain the conjectural inputs.
